reviews.title: Rediculous doesn’t use layer correctly…
reviews.text: Based in the UK, I chose the Footpath to make a route using hiking paths that are normally used by the ordinance survey in the UK. Each time I rooted to a point on the map it took me along the roads and ignored all the paths the layer was actually indicating that were available. I’ve cancelled the subscription even though it was a free trial…

reviews.title: Needs significant navigational improvements
reviews.text: hated this app. constantly was being told i was off route when the route wanted me on a busy road when I was next to it on the sidewalk. there’s no easy way to turn off that annoying and stupid voice. on a long run that is just a mood and vibe killer. contemplated running without headphones because it was that bad. it also got the elevation gain wrong by about 400 ft for an 18 mile run which is so significant. for urban running, i’m going back to just using apple maps since that shows on my watch. this was absolute trash.

reviews.title: Garbage
reviews.text: Buggy and doesn’t route very well, takes multiple times to get the line to trace where you want it. And almost all useful features are locked behind a payment plan. Outside the payment plan you get a basic picture and no details or directions.

reviews.title: Major roads aren’t footpaths as far as I’m aware…rubbish
reviews.text: I’ve been using this app for a while, the free version I might add, if you map things little by little it’s ok but if you want to map from here to there it takes you on major roads 🤯 I’m a runner! I don’t think running down a dual carriageway or motorway is a safe footpath, very disappointing

reviews.title: Not accurate for distance
reviews.text: At first I thought the app was great, allowing me easily to pre plan run routes while also have gps tell me which way to go while on my run but upon actually going on a run I realise the distance wasn’t accurate. I had preplanned a 5km run then went on the run. I was also wearing my Apple Watch. I finish this loop in 23 minutes. It normally takes me 40 minutes to do a 5K I have not improved that quickly as much as I would like to say I have. And upon looking at my Apple Watch, I had only run 2.6 Km. Due to this I will no longer be using the app
